_comment: The release the Talos overlay deploys, recorded so a digest can be tied to a tag offline.
A registry tag can be checked against nothing without the network, and a digest is opaque:
this file is the committed link between them. Values are index digests from the v<release>
GitHub release / GHCR multi-arch index, not per-platform manifests.
Do not edit by hand: `npm run release:bump-pins -- --version <release> ...` writes this
file, deploy/talos/kustomization.yaml and the allowlist in
fails when the three disagree, and with --tag it also fails when this release is not the
tag being built: a tag deploys the pins in its own tree, so v0.1.31 cut from a 0.1.30
tree deployed 0.1.30 images and nothing noticed.
